description: The workshop's shipped global agent configuration, installed onto a machine by adopt-global-rules. Two kinds: a per-host global instruction document (globals/) and discrete single-source rules fanned out to every host (rules/). Paths are relative to the skill directory; targets are relative to the home directory (or to --root). This is plugin payload — it ships with the plugin the same way its skills do, and changes to it are released, not configured per machine.
